instruction: Create a password policy in OpenLDAP
output:
cat > /tmp/ppolicy.ldif << 'EOF'
dn: cn=default,ou=policies,dc=example,dc=com
objectClass: pwdPolicy
objectClass: person
cn: default
sn: default
pwdAttribute: userPassword
pwdMinLength: 8
pwdMaxAge: 7776000
pwdInHistory: 5
pwdLockout: TRUE
pwdLockoutDuration: 300
pwdMaxFailure: 3
EOF

instruction: Enable the ppolicy overlay in OpenLDAP
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}ppolicy,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcPPolicyConfig
olcOverlay: ppolicy
olcPPolicyDefault: cn=default,ou=policies,dc=example,dc=com'

instruction: Create a LDAP replica consumer configuration
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcSyncrepl
olcSyncrepl: rid=123 provider=ldap://master:389 bindmethod=simple binddn=cn=replicator,dc=example,dc=com credentials=secret searchbase=dc=example,dc=com type=refreshAndPersist retry=60'

instruction: Configure OpenLDAP as a syncrepl provider (master)
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcServerID
olcServerID: 1 ldap://master.example.com'

instruction: Enable the syncprov overlay for a specific backend
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}syncprov,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcSyncProvConfig
olcOverlay: syncprov
olcSpSessionLog: 100'

instruction: Set the syncprov checkpoint interval
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}syncprov,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcSpCheckpoint
olcSpCheckpoint: 100 10'

instruction: Configure delta-syncrepl with accesslog database
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={2}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcMdbConfig
olcDatabase: {2}mdb
olcSuffix: cn=accesslog
olcDbDirectory: /var/lib/ldap/accesslog
olcRootDN: cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com'

instruction: Add the accesslog overlay for delta-syncrepl
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}accesslog,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcAccessLog
olcOverlay: accesslog
olcAccessLogDB: cn=accesslog
olcAccessLogOps: writes
olcAccessLogSuccess: TRUE'

instruction: Add the translucent overlay for LDAP proxying
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}translucent,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcTranslucent
olcOverlay: translucent'

instruction: Configure a LDAP proxy with translucent overlay
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcTranslucentURI
olcTranslucentURI: ldap://backend.example.com'

instruction: Enable the unique overlay for attribute uniqueness
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}unique,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcUniqueConfig
olcOverlay: unique
olcUniqueURI: ldap:///?uid?sub?(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)'

instruction: Add a constraint overlay for attribute validation
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}constraint,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcConstraintConfig
olcOverlay: constraint
olcConstraintAttribute: uidNumber integer 0..65535
olcConstraintAttribute: gidNumber integer 0..65535'

instruction: Enable the valsort overlay to sort attribute values
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}valsort,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcValSort
olcOverlay: valsort
olcValSortAttr: member'

instruction: Enable the pcache overlay for LDAP caching
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}cache,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcPcacheConfig
olcOverlay: cache
olcPcache: 1000 600 3600 100'

instruction: Add the retcode overlay for testing LDAP responses
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}retcode,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcRetCodeConfig
olcOverlay: retcode
olcRetCode: cn=test1,dc=example,dc=com LDAP_SUCCESS'

instruction: Enable the memberOf overlay with dangling ignore
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}memberof,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcMemberOfDangling
olcMemberOfDangling: ignore
-
add: olcMemberOfRefInt
olcMemberOfRefInt: TRUE'

instruction: Enable the refint referential integrity overlay
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={1}refint,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcRefintConfig
olcOverlay: refint
olcRefintAttribute: member manager'

instruction: Set up the dynlist overlay for dynamic groups
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcOverlay={0}dynlist,olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: add
objectClass: olcDynamicList
olcOverlay: dynlist
olcDlAttrSet: {0}ou groupURL'

instruction: Enable the authzid policy for SASL authorization
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcAuthzPolicy
olcAuthzPolicy: from'

instruction: Set up SASL regex mapping in OpenLDAP
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcAuthzRegexp
olcAuthzRegexp: uid=([^,]+),cn=.*,cn=auth ldap:///dc=example,dc=com??sub?(uid=$1)'

instruction: Test OpenLDAP configuration without starting
output: slaptest -u -d 1

instruction: Debug an LDAP search by showing protocol ops
output: ldapsearch -x -b dc=example,dc=com -d 1 '(uid=jdoe)'

instruction: Check LDAP server info with root DSE search
output: ldapsearch -x -b '' -s base vendorName

instruction: Get the root DSE supported features
output: ldapsearch -x -b '' -s base supportedExtension supportedControl
